title: Compare batching schedulers
description: This simulation estimates time and throughput for static and continuous request batching.

steps.description: The parameters set prefill and decode estimates plus a decode multiplier for each batch size. A seeded loop creates 32 requests with varied prompt and output lengths.
static_batching groups requests into fixed-size batches. The longest prompt and longest output in each batch set its wall-clock times.
continuous_batching keeps a waiting queue and active slots. It prefills requests as it fills the initial batch.

steps.question: When an active request finishes, what does continuous batching do with its slot if work is waiting?
steps.answer: It removes the finished request and immediately prefills the next queued request into that slot.

steps.description: Each decode step advances every active request by one token. Finished requests free slots for waiting requests until no requests remain.
The reporting loop tests batch sizes 1, 4, and 8. It calculates time and output-token throughput for both strategies.
The output prints one static and one continuous row for each batch size.
The final lines print the total output tokens and state that larger batches improve throughput without directly improving an individual request's TTFT or TPOT.
